{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Contains only a release note (doc/release-notes-34132.md) accompanying the code change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Release notes that accompany functional code changes belong to the affected area rather than docs."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies error handling in src/index/base.cpp, src/index/base.h, and src/index/txindex.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Ensures that txindex consistency errors and block-file lookup failures do not leave the node operating on corrupted index storage. The PR description notes that previously, 'A corrupt txindex point read can consequently fail one RPC while the node continues running,' directly addressing optional index data integrity."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/kernel/notifications_interface.h and the public header src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Routes database read failure notifications through the kernel notifications interface. While it updates kernel error reporting boundaries, reviewers note the approach remains contested because abrupt aborts impact host applications embedding the library."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/txmempool.cpp and src/txmempool.h (+1/-1 each).",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits in mempool files are minor mechanical call-site adjustments following from the coins view refactoring."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/blockchain.cpp (+1/-0).",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "A single-line change adapting to the internal database API does not constitute an RPC interface change."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches unit tests, fuzz harnesses, and test framework files for coins and dbwrapper.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test modifications pin the specific behavior of the database and index changes rather than developing general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/dbwrapper.* and removes lines in src/init.cpp.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Under category guidelines, CDBWrapper and LevelDB changes are part of validation rather than utils."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled 'UTXO Db and Indexes', modifying src/coins.*, src/txdb.*, src/dbwrapper.*, and chainstate views.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Stops deserialization failures from masquerading as missing coin entries and simplifies chainstate error handling. As the description explains, 'CDBWrapper::Read() returns false on deserialization failures (which can mask database corruption as missing keys),' directly threatening chainstate integrity, while also eliminating the redundant CCoinsViewErrorCatcher layer."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
